ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant high-intensity white pixels cover approximately 85% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity black pixels accounting for roughly 15% concentrated at the margins and center.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central vertical column of low-intensity black pigmentation at the peduncle junction; extensive high-intensity white contiguous blobs across the interior of both lobes; localized black pigmentation clusters along the trailing edge and distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly towards the distal tips where the edge appears more eroded.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to both lobes, exhibiting an upward sweep trajectory from the median notch to the lateral distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark-pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; fine-grain dark mottling clusters detected surrounding the median notch area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; three prominent parallel tracks on the left lobe and two shorter tracks on the right lobe near the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical black pigmented stripe at the fluke center; multiple linear rake marks on the ventral surface; irregular jagged erosion of the trailing edge at the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique central vertical pigmentation pattern resembling a textured dark column extending into the median notch.
